meta.name: implementing-api-patterns
meta.description: API design and implementation across REST, GraphQL, gRPC, and tRPC patterns. Use when building backend services, public APIs, or service-to-service communication. Covers REST frameworks (FastAPI, Axum, Gin, Hono), GraphQL libraries (Strawberry, async-graphql, gqlgen, Pothos), gRPC (Tonic, Connect-Go), tRPC for TypeScript, pagination strategies (cursor-based, offset-based), rate limiting, caching, versioning, and OpenAPI documentation generation. Includes frontend integration patterns for forms, tables, dashboards, and ai-chat skills.

copy.tagline: 设计并实现多种 API 模式，涵盖 REST、GraphQL、gRPC 和 tRPC。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要构建或集成后端 API，并希望掌握多种通信模式。
